column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules configuration (TSV format)
# This file tunes ZAP's baseline scanner for the KrishiSetu API surface.
# - Uses Bearer JWT auth (no cookies for API; cookies only for refresh)
# - Has its own CSP / HSTS / X-Frame-Options headers (verified by tests)
# Rules that are noisy / irrelevant for our JSON API are set to IGNORE.
# Rules that catch real misconfigurations are kept at FAIL or WARN.
# Headers — kept enabled, our middleware should pass all of these

column3: # Anti-CSRF Tokens Check (we have our own double-submit)
# Source Code Disclosure (rare but worth catching)
# Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
# Information Disclosure — Suspicious Comments in Source
